extracted.intended_audience: readers of Wikipedia / fans and researchers interested in television awards for the series
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled listing of award categories, nominations, and wins for the television series 'What We Do in the Shadows', showing which organizations nominated or awarded the show, individuals, or specific episodes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding Achievement in Sound Mixing for Television Series – Half Hour
rubrics_metrics.description: Cinema Audio Society Awards category recognizing excellence in sound mixing for half-hour television series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples from page: nominations include Rob Beal, Samuel Ejnes, Diego Gat, Stacey Michaels (for "Local News"); other-year nominees: Rob Beal, Diego Gat, Christina Wen, Caitlin McDaid, Judah Getz, Alex Jongbloed (for "Nandor's Army").

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in Sci‑Fi/Fantasy Television
rubrics_metrics.description: Costume Designers Guild Awards category honoring outstanding costume design in science-fiction or fantasy television.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example from page: Laura Montgomery nominated (for "Pride Parade").
